messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@stratahealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot playlist & decision owners — next steps

Hi Daniel / Priya — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed pilot "playlist" so your team can review and share with stakeholders. I captured the north-star goals we discussed and mapped tentative owners and target dates.

High-level pain & goals
- Pain: inconsistent latency at scale for inference, billing surprises with current infra, and lack of observability across models.
- Goal: 95th-pct latency under 400ms for key flows, predictable per-token costs, and dashboards for model-level quality/regression alerts.

Proposed pilot playlist (minimal viable scope)
1) Baseline & telemetry (Owner: Priya / StrataEng) — collect representative traffic traces and key prompts (Target: week of 6/28)
2) Proof-of-inference (Owner: Aditya / Redwood AE + Soojin) — 1-week evaluation on Redwood Hosted with your sample prompts, measure latency + cost (Target: 7/5)
3) Optimization pass (Owner: Redwood Infra — Karthik) — batching, KV cache tuning, and quantization recommendation for your workload (Target: 7/12)
4) Success verification & rollout plan (Owner: Monica / CSM) — define SLOs and rollout steps for production (Target: 7/19)

Decision path & stakeholders
- Technical approval: Priya Sharma (StrataHealth, Head of ML)
- Procurement/Commercial: Olivia Trent (Procurement) and Daniel Park (Exec sponsor)
- Security/compliance checkpoint if needed: security assessment and SOC2 evidence (we can provide via portal)

Immediate asks (for this week)
- Priya: share 2–3 representative request traces and a sample prompt set (anonymized) — link to upload here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdocs
- Olivia/Daniel: can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether a standalone SOW will be required for the pilot?

Attachments: I attached a first-draft MAP workbook and a SOW template for your review (files: StrataHealth_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_template_Redwood.pdf).

If this aligns, we'll lock dates and I will create a HubSpot milestone with owners. Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if useful.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

Hi Priya / Daniel — quick note on success criteria and onboarding steps from CS: 

Success criteria (what we'll measure at pilot close)
- Latency: 95th-pct for the prioritized endpoint < 400ms under pilot load
- Cost: per-engagement unit cost reduction compared to your current baseline (we'll compute after telemetry)
- Quality: no regression in top-5 intent accuracy on the prompt set provided

Onboarding checklist
- Upload telemetry + sample prompts to the Drive link (Soojin's email).
- Sign pilot SOW (attached) — Olivia, if SOW PO is preferable, we can accept that instead.
- Kickoff call (30 mins) week of 6/28 to align telemetry and trial keys. Monica to run.

I'll prepare a short validation runbook and share by Monday 6/28. Let me know if there are other stakeholders we should include in the kickoff (security/compliance contact).

Best,
